cards.title: Running totals
cards.body: Start a total at 0 before the loop, then add to it each time round.

hi.title: Running total
hi.body: Loop se pehle total 0 se shuru karo, phir har round mein usme jodte jao.

cards.title: Reading inside a loop
cards.body: Each `prompt()` reads the next line, so calling it inside a loop reads one line per round.

hi.title: Loop ke andar padhna
hi.body: Har `prompt()` agli line padhta hai, isliye loop ke andar call karne par har round mein ek line padhi jaati hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print 10, but crashes with `ReferenceError: total is not defined`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: Line 2 makes a new `total` inside the loop every round, and it is gone after the loop. Declare it once, before the loop.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 10 print karna chahiye, par yeh `ReferenceError: total is not defined` dekar crash hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Line 2 har round mein loop ke andar naya `total` banati hai, aur loop ke baad woh gayab ho jaata hai. Use ek baar, loop se pehle declare karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The loop runs 3 times and adds 2 each time.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Loop 3 baar chalta hai aur har baar 2 jodta hai.

exercise.prompt: The first line is a count N; then N lines follow, each with one whole number. Print their sum.
exercise.promptHi: Pehli line mein count N hai; phir N lines aati hain, har ek mein ek whole number. Unka sum print karo.
